knots=np.linspace(0.3,6,12)
def hat(x):
    B=np.zeros((len(x),len(knots)))
    for j in range(len(knots)):
        e=np.zeros(len(knots)); e[j]=1
        B[:,j]=np.interp(x,knots,e)
    return B

def equation(t, P, params):
    f = params[0] + params[1]*P + params[2]*P**2 + params[3]/P + params[4]*np.sqrt(P)
